dogecoin.text: @elonmusk is trying to get @dogecoin to replace @Bitcoin in market cap. That's what he means by "to the moon". 1st, he promotes @Bitcoin to get BTC crowds on board, then promotes Doge with the support of BTC maxis. After he gets the mainstream attention he dumps Bitcoin. Clever.
